name: KiCad Project Manager
description: Inspect the active KiCad project; foundation for project setup and KiBot workflows.
description_full: A native wxPython IPC companion for KiCad 9. This preview displays the active project, board, KiCad version, and presence of KiBot/CI files. It does not modify project files. Enable the KiCad API in Preferences → Plugins. Linux requires Python pip, venv, and distro-provided wxPython. Project editing, standards presets, and KiBot controls are planned for later releases.
